# MineTrans Insurance Brokers

> Specialist mining and marine insurance brokerage serving South Africa and Sub-Saharan Africa. MineTrans structures insurance for mine assets, liability, business interruption, plant and machinery, and land, air and sea transit. FSP 53166.

Canonical website: https://www.minetrans.co.za/

## Core services
- Mining commercial assets, liability and business interruption: https://www.minetrans.co.za/insurance-mine.html
- Mining plant and machinery insurance: https://www.minetrans.co.za/insurance-machinery.html
- Marine, land and air transit insurance: https://www.minetrans.co.za/insurance-transit.html
- Business interruption methodology and assessment: https://www.minetrans.co.za/bi-methodology.html
- Mining risk analysis: https://www.minetrans.co.za/risk.html

## Entity information
MineTrans Insurance Brokers is a specialist insurance brokerage focused on mining and marine risk. It is a division of Donaldson Advisory Group and operates in South Africa and Sub-Saharan Africa. Financial Services Provider number: FSP 53166.
